verdict.rationale: CockroachDB exposes a SQL/Postgres-wire API for all data operations and a `ccloud` CLI for cluster lifecycle management, plus an MCP server letting AI agents query schemas and run statements, but there's no explicit documentation claiming full API/CLI parity with the Cloud console (billing views, resource-usage dashboards, cluster management UI) — missing for 10: explicit UI/API parity statement, coverage of console-only features like billing/monitoring dashboards via API, independent confirmation that all cloud console actions are scriptable.
